controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: JAXA’s mapped 548.9 nm reflectance from the 10 July 2018 BOX-A observations. The source grid is 0.2° per pixel and missing values are explicitly marked. This monochrome view uses the published corrected reflectance, with a display stretch; it does not reconstruct missing poles.
controls.summary: Corrected reflectance at 548.9 nm is stretched for display. The July 2018 observations leave the poles unobserved.
controls.title: ONC 548.9 nm reflectance map

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: The mapping team’s published color composite assigns the p, v and ul filters to red, green and blue. It includes near-infrared light and is not natural color. Global brightness and contrast were matched across observations, so these mosaic values are unsuitable for quantitative photometry. Local residual shadows remain.
controls.summary: False colors show differences between images. Brightness matching changes the mosaic values; they are not measured reflectance.
controls.title: ONC false-color composite

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows radius minus a 448 m reference sphere, including the body's broad irregular shape. This is not gravitational height or an image observation. Brightness adds cartographic relief from the full source model; Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting. Fine terrain is represented in the map while the displayed silhouette is simplified. Values follow the nearest corresponding point on the full source shape within the display mesh’s simplification allowance. This is radial height, not gravitational height; flat previews withhold overlapping radial surfaces.
controls.summary: Height relative to a 448 m sphere, from the shape model. Colors include Ryugu's broad form; the outline is simplified.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
